verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .
verses.literalPt: FALOU mais o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão dizendo:

verses.original: זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר דַּבֵּ֣ר׀ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֣וּ אֵלֶיךָ֩ פָרָ֨ה אֲדֻמָּ֜ה תְּמִימָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵֽין־ בָּהּ֙ מ֔וּם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ עָלָ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ עֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ ḥuq·qaṯ hat·tō·w·rāh ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh lê·mōr dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yiq·ḥū ’ê·le·ḵā p̄ā·rāh ’ă·ḏum·māh tə·mî·māh ’ă·šer ’ên- bāh mūm ’ă·šer lō- ‘ā·lāh ‘ā·le·hā ‘ōl
verses.literal: This is the statute of the law that the LORD . . . has commanded Instruct . . . the Israelites . . . to bring you an unblemished red heifer that has no defect and has never been placed under a yoke
verses.literalPt: Este é o estatuto da lei, que o SENHOR ordenou, dizendo: Dize aos filhos de Israel que te tragam uma novilha ruiva, que não tenha defeito, e sobre a qual não tenha sido posto jugo.

verses.original: וּנְתַתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔הּ אֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְהוֹצִ֤יא אֹתָהּ֙ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֹתָ֖הּ לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯat·tem ’ō·ṯāh ’el- ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·hō·w·ṣî ’ō·ṯāh ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’ō·ṯāh lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Give it to Eleazar the priest and he will have it brought - outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence
verses.literalPt: E a dareis a Eleazar, o sacerdote; ele a tirará para fora do arraial, e degolar-se-á diante dele.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֞ח אֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מִדָּמָ֖הּ בְּאֶצְבָּע֑וֹ וְהִזָּ֞ה אֶל־ נֹ֨כַח פְּנֵ֧י אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֛ד מִדָּמָ֖הּ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên mid·dā·māh bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw wə·hiz·zāh ’el- nō·ḵaḥ pə·nê ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ mid·dā·māh še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm
verses.literal: Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward . . . the front of the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: E Eleazar, o sacerdote, tomará do seu sangue com o seu dedo, e dele espargirá para a frente da tenda da congregação sete vezes.

verses.original: וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֶת־ הַפָּרָ֖ה לְעֵינָ֑יו אֶת־ עֹרָ֤הּ וְאֶת־ בְּשָׂרָהּ֙ וְאֶת־ דָּמָ֔הּ עַל־ פִּרְשָׁ֖הּ יִשְׂרֹֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śā·rap̄ ’eṯ- hap·pā·rāh lə·‘ê·nāw ’eṯ- ‘ō·rāh wə·’eṯ- bə·śā·rāh wə·’eṯ- dā·māh ‘al- pir·šāh yiś·rōp̄
verses.literal: Then the heifer must be burned in his sight Its hide its flesh and its blood are to be burned along with its dung
verses.literalPt: Então queimará a novilha perante os seus olhos; o seu couro, e a sua carne, e o seu sangue, com o seu esterco, se queimará.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֣ח הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עֵ֥ץ אֶ֛רֶז וְאֵז֖וֹב וּשְׁנִ֣י תוֹלָ֑עַת וְהִשְׁלִ֕יךְ אֶל־ תּ֖וֹךְ שְׂרֵפַ֥ת הַפָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên ‘êṣ ’e·rez wə·’ê·zō·wḇ ū·šə·nî ṯō·w·lā·‘aṯ wə·hiš·lîḵ ’el- tō·wḵ śə·rê·p̄aṯ hap·pā·rāh
verses.literal: The priest is to take cedar wood hyssop and scarlet wool . . . and throw them onto the burning heifer
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote tomará pau de cedro, e hissopo, e carmesim, e os lançará no meio do fogo que queima a novilha.

verses.original: וְכִבֶּ֨ס בְּגָדָ֜יו הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְרָחַ֤ץ בְּשָׂרוֹ֙ בַּמַּ֔יִם וְאַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְטָמֵ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw hak·kō·hên wə·rā·ḥaṣ bə·śā·rōw bam·ma·yim wə·’a·ḥar yā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh wə·ṭā·mê hak·kō·hên ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water after that he may enter . . . the camp but he will be ceremonially unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote lavará as suas vestes, e banhará a sua carne na água, e depois entrará no arraial; e o sacerdote será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְהַשֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔הּ יְכַבֵּ֤ס בְּגָדָיו֙ בַּמַּ֔יִם וְרָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּ֑יִם וְטָמֵ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haś·śō·rêp̄ ’ō·ṯāh yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw bam·ma·yim wə·rā·ḥaṣ bə·śā·rōw bam·mā·yim wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: The one who burned the heifer must also wash his clothes and bathe his body . . . in water and he too will be ceremonially unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Também o que a queimou lavará as suas vestes com água, e em água banhará a sua carne, e imundo será até à tarde.

verses.original: וְאָסַ֣ף׀ אִ֣ישׁ טָה֗וֹר אֵ֚ת אֵ֣פֶר הַפָּרָ֔ה וְהִנִּ֛יחַ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה בְּמָק֣וֹם טָה֑וֹר וְ֠הָיְתָה לַעֲדַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְמִשְׁמֶ֛רֶת לְמֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה חַטָּ֥את הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·sap̄ ’îš ṭā·hō·wr ’êṯ ’ê·p̄er hap·pā·rāh wə·hin·nî·aḥ mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh bə·mā·qō·wm ṭā·hō·wr wə·hā·yə·ṯāh la·‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·miš·me·reṯ lə·mê nid·dāh ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ hî
verses.literal: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to gather up the ashes of the heifer and store them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp They must be kept by the congregation . . . of Israel for preparing the water of purification this is for purification from sin
verses.literalPt: E um homem limpo ajuntará a cinza da novilha, e a porá fora do arraial, num lugar limpo, e ficará ela guardada para a congregação dos filhos de Israel, para a água da separação; expiação é.

verses.original: וְ֠כִבֶּס הָאֹסֵ֨ף אֶת־ אֵ֤פֶר הַפָּרָה֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְטָמֵ֖א עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּ֛ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵib·bes hā·’ō·sêp̄ ’eṯ- ’ê·p̄er hap·pā·rāh ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ṭā·mê ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ wə·hā·yə·ṯāh liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·lag·gêr hag·gār bə·ṯō·w·ḵām lə·ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The man who has gathered up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes and he will be ceremonially unclean until evening This is a permanent statute for the Israelites . . . and for the foreigner residing among them
verses.literalPt: E o que apanhou a cinza da novilha lavará as suas vestes, e será imundo até à tarde; isto será por estatuto perpétuo aos filhos de Israel e ao estrangeiro que peregrina no meio deles.

verses.original: הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּמֵ֖ת לְכָל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם וְטָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·mêṯ lə·ḵāl ne·p̄eš ’ā·ḏām wə·ṭā·mê šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Whoever touches any dead body will be unclean for seven days
verses.literalPt: Aquele que tocar em algum morto, cadáver de algum homem, imundo será sete dias.

verses.original: ה֣וּא יִתְחַטָּא־ ב֞וֹ בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י יִטְהָ֑ר וְאִם־ לֹ֨א יִתְחַטָּ֜א בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י לֹ֥א יִטְהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hū yiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭā- ḇōw bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î yiṭ·hār wə·’im- lō yiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭā bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î lō yiṭ·hār
verses.literal: He must purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day then he will be clean But if he does not purify himself on the third . . . and seventh days he will not be clean
verses.literalPt: Ao terceiro dia se purificará com aquela água, e ao sétimo dia será limpo; mas, se ao terceiro dia se não purificar, não será limpo ao sétimo dia.

verses.original: כָּֽל־ הַנֹּגֵ֡עַ בְּמֵ֣ת בְּנֶפֶשׁ֩ הָאָדָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר־ יָמ֜וּת וְלֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֗א אֶת־ מִשְׁכַּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ טִמֵּ֔א וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּי֩ מֵ֨י נִדָּ֜ה לֹא־ זֹרַ֤ק עָלָיו֙ טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה ע֖וֹד טֻמְאָת֥וֹ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·mêṯ bə·ne·p̄eš hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer- yā·mūṯ wə·lō yiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭā ’eṯ- miš·kan Yah·weh ṭim·mê wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mî·yiś·rā·’êl kî mê nid·dāh lō- zō·raq ‘ā·lāw ṭā·mê yih·yeh ‘ō·wḏ ṭum·’ā·ṯōw ḇōw
verses.literal: Anyone who touches a human - corpse . . . and fails to purify himself defiles the tabernacle of the LORD That person must be cut off from Israel He remains unclean because the water of purification has not been sprinkled on him and his uncleanness is still on him
verses.literalPt: Todo aquele que tocar em algum morto, cadáver de algum homem, e não se purificar, contamina o tabernáculo do SENHOR; e aquela pessoa será extirpada de Israel; porque a água da separação não foi espargida sobre ele, imundo será; está nele ainda a sua imundícia.

verses.original: זֹ֚את הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אָדָ֖ם כִּֽי־ יָמ֣וּת בְּאֹ֑הֶל כָּל־ הַבָּ֤א אֶל־ הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאֹ֔הֶל יִטְמָ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hat·tō·w·rāh ’ā·ḏām kî- yā·mūṯ bə·’ō·hel kāl- hab·bā ’el- hā·’ō·hel wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer bā·’ō·hel yiṭ·mā šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: This is the law when a person dies in a tent Everyone who enters . . . the tent and everyone already in the tent will be unclean for seven days
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei, quando morrer algum homem em alguma tenda, todo aquele que entrar naquela tenda, e todo aquele que nela estiver, será imundo sete dias.

verses.original: וְכֹל֙ כְּלִ֣י פָת֔וּחַ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵין־ צָמִ֥יד פָּתִ֖יל עָלָ֑יו טָמֵ֖א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl kə·lî p̄ā·ṯū·aḥ ’ă·šer ’ên- ṣā·mîḏ pā·ṯîl ‘ā·lāw ṭā·mê hū
verses.literal: and any open container without a lid fastened on it is unclean . . .
verses.literalPt: Também todo o vaso aberto, sobre o qual não houver pano atado, será imundo.

verses.original: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּ֜ע עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה בַּֽחֲלַל־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְמֵ֔ת אֽוֹ־ בְעֶ֥צֶם אָדָ֖ם א֣וֹ בְקָ֑בֶר יִטְמָ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yig·ga‘ ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh ba·ḥă·lal- ḥe·reḇ ’ōw ḇə·mêṯ ’ōw- ḇə·‘e·ṣem ’ā·ḏām ’ōw ḇə·qā·ḇer yiṭ·mā šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Anyone in the open field . . . who touches someone who has been killed by the sword or has died of natural causes or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave will be unclean for seven days
verses.literalPt: E todo aquele que sobre a face do campo tocar em alguém que for morto pela espada, ou em outro morto ou nos ossos de algum homem, ou numa sepultura, será imundo sete dias.

verses.original: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ לַטָּמֵ֔א מֵעֲפַ֖ר שְׂרֵפַ֣ת הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְנָתַ֥ן עָלָ֛יו מַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים אֶל־ כֶּֽלִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qə·ḥū laṭ·ṭā·mê mê·‘ă·p̄ar śə·rê·p̄aṯ ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·nā·ṯan ‘ā·lāw ma·yim ḥay·yîm ’el- ke·lî
verses.literal: For the purification of the unclean person, take some of the ashes of the burnt sin offering put them in a jar and pour fresh water over them
verses.literalPt: Para um imundo, pois, tomarão da cinza da queima da expiação, e sobre ela colocarão água corrente num vaso.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח אֵז֜וֹב וְטָבַ֣ל בַּמַּיִם֮ אִ֣ישׁ טָהוֹר֒ וְהִזָּ֤ה עַל־ הָאֹ֙הֶל֙ וְעַל־ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְעַל־ הַנְּפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽיוּ־ שָׁ֑ם וְעַל־ הַנֹּגֵ֗עַ בַּעֶ֙צֶם֙ א֣וֹ בֶֽחָלָ֔ל א֥וֹ בַמֵּ֖ת א֥וֹ בַקָּֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ ’ê·zō·wḇ wə·ṭā·ḇal bam·ma·yim ’îš ṭā·hō·wr wə·hiz·zāh ‘al- hā·’ō·hel wə·‘al- kāl- hak·kê·lîm wə·‘al- han·nə·p̄ā·šō·wṯ ’ă·šer hā·yū- šām wə·‘al- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ ba·‘e·ṣem ’ōw ḇe·ḥā·lāl ’ōw ḇam·mêṯ ’ōw ḇaq·qā·ḇer
verses.literal: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop dip it in the water and sprinkle . . . the tent . . . all the furnishings . . . and the people who were there . . . He is also to sprinkle the one who touched a bone a grave or a person who has died . . . or been slain . . .
verses.literalPt: E um homem limpo tomará hissopo, e o molhará naquela água, e a espargirá sobre aquela tenda, e sobre todos os móveis, e sobre as pessoas que ali estiverem, como também sobre aquele que tocar os ossos, ou em alguém que foi morto, ou que faleceu, ou numa sepultura.

verses.original: וְהִזָּ֤ה הַטָּהֹר֙ עַל־ הַטָּמֵ֔א בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֖י וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְחִטְּאוֹ֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וְכִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛יו וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵ֥ר בָּעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·zāh haṭ·ṭā·hōr ‘al- haṭ·ṭā·mê bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î wə·ḥiṭ·ṭə·’ōw bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î wə·ḵib·bes bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·hêr bā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: The man who is ceremonially clean . . . is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day After he purifies the unclean person on the seventh day the one being cleansed must wash his clothes and bathe in water and that evening he will be clean
verses.literalPt: E o limpo ao terceiro e sétimo dia espargirá sobre o imundo; e ao sétimo dia o purificará; e lavará as suas vestes, e se banhará na água, e à tarde será limpo.

verses.original: וְאִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יִטְמָא֙ וְלֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֔א וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַקָּהָ֑ל כִּי֩ אֶת־ מִקְדַּ֨שׁ יְהוָ֜ה טִמֵּ֗א מֵ֥י נִדָּ֛ה לֹא־ זֹרַ֥ק עָלָ֖יו טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ’ă·šer- yiṭ·mā wə·lō yiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭā wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w mit·tō·wḵ haq·qā·hāl kî ’eṯ- miq·daš Yah·weh ṭim·mê mê nid·dāh lō- zō·raq ‘ā·lāw ṭā·mê hū
verses.literal: But if a person who is unclean does not purify himself he will be cut off from the assembly because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him he is unclean
verses.literalPt: Porém o que for imundo, e se não purificar, do meio da congregação será ele extirpado; porquanto contaminou o santuário do SENHOR; água de separação sobre ele não foi espargida; imundo é.

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָּהֶ֖ם לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּמַזֵּ֤ה מֵֽי־ הַנִּדָּה֙ יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔יו וְהַנֹּגֵ֙עַ֙ בְּמֵ֣י הַנִּדָּ֔ה יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lå̄·hɛm lə·ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām ū·maz·zêh mê- han·nid·dāh yə·ḵab·bês bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bə·mê han·nid·dāh yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: This is a permanent statute for the people The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes and whoever touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: Isto lhes será por estatuto perpétuo; e o que espargir a água da separação lavará as suas vestes; e o que tocar a água da separação será imundo até à tarde,

verses.original: וְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּע־ בּ֥וֹ הַטָּמֵ֖א יִטְמָ֑א וְהַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַנֹּגַ֖עַת תִּטְמָ֥א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yig·ga‘- bōw haṭ·ṭā·mê yiṭ·mā wə·han·ne·p̄eš han·nō·ḡa·‘aṯ tiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Anything the unclean person touches will become unclean and anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E tudo o que tocar o imundo também será imundo; e a pessoa que o tocar será imunda até à tarde.
